records.title: Influence of Ageing and Post-Processing on the Mechanical and Aesthetic Stability of PA12-Based 3D-Printed Components for Medical Devices
claim_notes: Materials 18(19), 4478; published 2025-09-25; PMID 41095305; PMCID PMC12525880. Ana Paula Piedade is the editor, not an author.
Retained Europe PMC XML: 229979 bytes, SHA-256 4d930d221c67d38199460f1f80b86a2a724a0b2986a77e09081172d5a83c42d7. This hash identifies retained XML, not a PDF or a fresh download.

The article-specific permissions state CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). The selected original Table 7 result has no separate third-party credit. Manufacturer-derived Tables 1 and 2 and source assets are excluded.
Table 7 also reports excluded SLS Reference modulus 1.41 GPa, SD 0.04 GPa, CV 3.48%; that unresolved statistical discrepancy is preserved, not repaired or imported.

PA2200 is treated only as a source-designated EOS grade for one source-qualified PA12 representative. No distinct-chemistry inference from trade names, universal grade equivalence, or medical suitability/certification claim.

Additional selected SLS scope: Table7 aged moduli and Table8 strength/modulus. Age/treatment states reuse the existing EOS PA2200 identity. Table6 route ambiguity, inconsistent companion statistics, HP identity mapping and elongation quantities remain outside this draft. Conditional CV compatibility does not prove scientific validity.

2026-11-03 four existing SLS state break-elongation supplements:dyed375h and dyed+smoothedReference/375h/750h,original epsilon Mean/Std/CV percent strings,n6 per group. SD absolute percentage points,CV relativepercent;conditional rounding compatibility not scientific certification. DyedReference/750h elongation statistics remain deferred;no newstates orHPidentity. Unknown gauge/strain/rupture/recovery retained;chamberhours not fieldmonths,no engine/allowable.
